notes.title: Update 0.40 is Here! Conquest/Domination Mode, New Features and much more!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42531213/469c4dc7d9eea968be07b9626f3afd805de1f361.png[/img]
[h2]Greeting Strategists![/h2]

[b]First of all, we want to thank you for your patience.[/b]
This update took longer than expected due to a critical bug that many community members had reported — units becoming unresponsive or refusing to move. Fixing it required extensive testing and a major rewrite of core systems. The good news? It’s been [b]100% resolved.[/b]

Along the way, we also added several highly requested features that many of you had been asking for!

A huge thank you to everyone who took the time to report bugs and provide feedback — your support is what keeps this project moving forward and evolving! 🚀

Below is the list with all the content of this [b]update[/b]:

[h3]New features/content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Conquest/Domination Game Mode: 4 exclusive maps for Conquest/Domination Mode[/b]
(+3 more currently in development and coming soon!)
[*] Hotkey icons added to all buttons in the command panel for quicker access.
[*] Added New campaign objective window now shows main goals directly in-game.
[*] Added a red indicator in the Hint Window when you don't have enough resources or population to perform an action.
[*] FPS Optimization for High-Unit-Count Scenarios (Performance boost of 10-20% depending on PC specs)
[*] Improved Unit Pathfinding
[*] [b]Unit Colision & Formation System:[/b]
- Better Unit Collision System
- Enhanced Formation System (Formations now perform better with large groups of units)
- Improved Unit Handling System (Better responsiveness and control when managing large groups of units)
[*] [b]Workshop Enhancements:[/b]
- Added Automatic Image Upload System for item previews in the Workshop (Uploaded or updated maps now generate preview images without user input)
- Users can now upload custom preview images for Workshop items (Use "steampreview.png" in the created map folder)
- Default minimaps are now displayed in-game menus if no custom minimap is provided
- Fixed Minimaps in Editor (No longer displays a minimap from a previously loaded map in menus)
[*] Added Full Russian Voice Localization
[*] New lighting added to the map of Mission 4 in the Crusades campaign.
[*] Added Victory Sound when completing campaigns
[/list]

[h3]Bug/Error Correction:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where certain units would sometimes become immobile and unusable.
[*] Fixed a bug causing large armies to occasionally freeze and stop responding.
[*] Fixed a bug where units would often become unusable when fighting on bridges, getting stuck underneath them.
[*] [b]Multiplayer Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed Desync triggers related to unit recruitment across all civilizations.
- Fixed Desync triggers involving heroes: Hermann and Walter (Crusaders), and Batu Khan (Mongols).
- Fixed Desync trigger linked to unit recruitment in the Arab Mercenary Camp.
- Fixed Mercenary Camp Multiplayer Bug in Arabians (Prevented players from repeatedly recruiting mercenary templates with fast clicks)
[*] Fixed a bug that miscalculated hero costs when re-recruiting them after death and level progression.
[*] Fixed Worker Command Display Bug for Support Units
[/list]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balanced Wall Construction Cost and Time (Walls are now more practical and useful in gameplay)
[*] Balance adjustments: Increased health and damage points gained by heroes with each level up.
[/list]

I hope you like this update and feel free to give your [b]feedback or any suggestions[/b] as always.

[h2][b]Official Discord of the game:[/b][/h2][h2][b][url=https://discord.gg/xF45EuHvm8]Link[/url][/b][/h2]

notes.title: Update 0.30: Steam Workshop Available, New Map and Improvements!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42531213/469c4dc7d9eea968be07b9626f3afd805de1f361.png[/img]
[h2][b]Greeting Strategists![/b][/h2]
First of all, [b]thank you[/b] all for supporting the project and continuing to build such a [b]fantastic community[/b].

It is a pleasure to announce this [b]great update[/b], which stands out for adding a feature that many of you wanted, such as [b]Steam Workshop support[/b]. You already know that the community is the most important thing for me and I hope that this addition helps you to [b]enjoy the game[/b] a little more.

Below is the list with all the content of this [b]update[/b]:
[list]
[*] Steam Workshop support (how to use it is described below)
[*] New Map: (4) Friends of Our Enemies
[*] Added time cost indicator for all objects that require time for their production or construction (Buildings, units, researches, etc...).
[*] New sorting system in the selection of units, now grouped in a more intuitive and easy to control by the player.
[*] Added penalty effect on ranged units when attacked by a melee unit.
[*] Fixed critical bug that forced to restart the game after each multiplayer game to avoid the desync.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the overlapping of the penalty suffered by ranged units when attacked by a melee unit that caused their damage to be zero when attacked by numerous melee units.
[*] Fixed bug in which the flags of settlements healed neutral units.
[/list]

I hope you like this update and feel free to give your feedback or any suggestions as always.

[h2][b]Official Discord of the game:[/b][/h2][h2][b][url=https://discord.gg/xF45EuHvm8]Link[/url][/b][/h2]

[h2][b]Steam Workshop User Guide:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]To create a Workshop item and upload it:[/b][/h3]

1 - Open the game's Map Editor

2 - Create the map with all the features or modifications you want (You can create maps for new game modes, mission maps, great battles, simple skirmish maps, etc...)

3 - Save the map you have created

4 - In the editor toolbar, look for the File option, click and select the Steam Workshop option, where you can publish the Map in the Workshop or Update a Map that you have previously uploaded. 

You can look at the screenshot to see where the Steam Workshop option is located in the Editor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42531213/981cf1715917d5513d2e6183cdde27597b068700.png[/img]

5 - Finally, change the Item information in the Steam Workshop to your liking

[h3][b]To subscribe and download a Workshop map:[/b][/h3]

1 - Enter the game Workshop, from the game meeting point

2 - Browse the available maps

3 - Subscribe to the map you want to download

It will download automatically and appear in the game along with the other available maps

4 - If you want to delete a downloaded map, simply unsubscribe from it in the Workshop

notes.title: Developer Diary: Roadmap for the coming months
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42531213/469c4dc7d9eea968be07b9626f3afd805de1f361.png[/img][h2]Greetings Strategists![/h2]

First, thank you to all of you [b]who are supporting[/b] Ancient Wars: Medieval Crusaders.

Many of you have asked about the [b]game development plans[/b], so I have decided to publish the content and improvements that will arrive over the [b]next 6 months[/b]. To have the best possible [b]communication and transparency[/b] with the community.

The [b]content and improvements[/b] that the game will [b]receive[/b] during the next 6 months are:
[list]
[*] New campaign: Involved by Arabs, Byzantines and Mongols
[*] New Maps for Skirmish mode (for all sizes)
[*] Steam Workshop Introduction
[*] Multiplayer Improvement (Global Chat, stability, bug fixes)
[*] Better gameplay and civilization design
[*] Redesign of Current Maps
[*] Fix Animation Bugs
[*] Fix Other reported Bugs
[*] Game Balance
[/list]

I hope this [b]information helps[/b] you and do not hesitate to share your [b]opinion or suggestions[/b] in the comments. Community is always the [b]most important[/b] thing to me!

[h2][b]Official Discord of the game:[/b][/h2][h2][b][url=https://discord.gg/xF45EuHvm8]Link[/url][/b][/h2]

notes.title: Ancient Wars: Medieval Crusades is now available!

We are pleased to announce, that the new in the saga, [b]Ancient Wars: Medieval Crusades is now available![/b]

Many of you have been waiting for it and I have taken into account the [b]feedback from the community[/b] during the Betas to try to offer the best launch experience.

The game has the following [b]content[/b] at launch:

[*] 5 Asymmetric Civilizations: Arabs, Byzantines, Crusaders, Mongols and Russians

I hope you enjoy it and do not hesitate to contribute with your opinions as always to keep [b]improving the Ancient Wars saga[/b].
